valueScore.description: How strongly the shown experience proves product value.

clarityScore.description: How clearly the app communicates what to do and why it matters.

trustScore.description: How credible the product claim feels after the trace.

switchLikelihood.description: Likelihood that the persona would switch from their current alternative.

payLikelihood.description: Likelihood that the persona or buyer would pay for this product.

taskOutcome.description: Outcome of the persona's task after the deterministic app trace.

topObjection.description: Most important concrete objection blocking adoption.

missingCapability.description: Concrete missing capability or proof the persona expected.

momentOfDelight.description: Specific positive moment, or null if none.

momentOfConfusion.description: Specific confusing moment, or null if none.

verdict.description: Overall PMF pull indicated by the experience.

summary.description: Concise skeptical summary of what the trace did and did not prove.
